prior_summary: Blue-object-frame TCP pose diffusion makes pickup, alignment, lift and early transport equivariant to the blue pose resolved at each replan while retaining robot configuration and world reachability cues.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when blue is visibly present but displaced from the demonstrated +y source, especially before contact or during pickup/lift, with buffered red still plausibly located. Use typed arguments blue, blue_goal and red.
termination_guidance: Terminate or hand off when blue is stationary inside the observed blue goal and the gripper is open/clear. The supervised continuation may instead run through buffered-red closure and initial lift.
limitations: No contact truth or recovery evidence. A one-chunk object frame can become stale if blue slips; translated targets can be unreachable and do not guarantee collision avoidance, red preservation or grasp success. Prefer the goal-frame policy late near destination and the fresh-TCP policy for modest tracking offsets.
